The problem

Sales messages arrive as unstructured text. A reviewer needs the contact details, a suggested follow-up, and a duplicate check before adding the lead to the CRM.

How it works

Extract the proposed lead

A sample enquiry supplies a name, email, and interest. The workflow normalizes the email and prepares a follow-up for review.

Review before committing

The reviewer can edit the proposed lead fields. The extraction tool only proposes data, and the approval endpoint is the only route that writes a lead.

Handle duplicates and retries

Approval rechecks the normalized email inside the write transaction. Concurrent approvals resolve to one lead. Identical retries return the original result.

Engineering decisions

The CRM makes the final duplicate decision inside the transaction, even if two drafts initially appear unique. This keeps the approval flow consistent when several reviewers act at once.

What was tested

Four integration tests covered extraction, ambiguous contacts, concurrent approval, and untrusted model output. The CRM is a local sandbox. The optional OpenAI path was tested using a mocked response.
